posts.title: Analysis
posts.description: Analysis for software projects is the act of gathering, curating, and collating enough detailed information about a set of given problems that people would like to use software to solve. If it is complete enough, then it can be used as the sole reference for people creating designs for these solutions. It has all of the answers to all of the questions that a designer will have. posts.title: Difficult Problems
posts.description: In software, these days, if there is a fleet of existing interoperating systems, it is most likely that when they were developed, they focused on solving the majority of the easy problems. Often, it is also the case that, in doing that specific work, they made any related difficult problems far more difficult.
